chunk_map.heading: An opportunity tree on Friday, a feature roadmap on Monday

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L4: 'a tree' is introduced in the first sentence; L6 'The tree stays on the wall' and L8 'the roadmap' reuse earlier-named nouns (header names both). Closest: L8 'the roadmap already owned the sprints' - roadmap named in header and L6, sprints is a plain noun.
No cross-file pointer; grep for 'lecture|opening|earlier|previous|module' on body returns nothing. Closest L6 'On Monday the roadmap arrives' is in-slide scene.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'the X you did/saw' reference. Closest L4 'Everyone leaves agreeing' is a scene in this slide, not a beat reference.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no guess-before-reveal or demo beat; L4-8 are verbed narrative sentences, muted read holds

rules_evaluated.evidence: L4-8 carry a full claim: tree made, roadmap ignores it, cause was sprint cost. Closest to thin: L6 'On Monday the roadmap arrives as a list of features with dates. The tree stays on the wall.' but it sits between setup and cause in a three-paragraph slide.
Header 'An opportunity tree on Friday, a feature roadmap on Monday' is literally true of L4 and L6 and the body explains why (L8).

No 'Not X. Not Y. Z.'; L8 'The team was not careless.' is a single negation followed by a cause, not a triple. No anaphora triple, no superlative, no number, no verb triplet. Closest: L8 'cost a sprint per branch' is concrete.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No repo vocabulary. Closest: L4/L8 'branch' and 'tree' are the opportunity-tree artifact's own ordinary terms, attested in the maintainer Guard (Torres's tree).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -c '\*\*' on body lines 1-9 returns 0; no bold.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: slide file is inlined into its host deck by include; presence belongs to the host composition, one ## chunk here

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no Phase/Step headers; check-slide-numbering.js --file -> 'OK - 1 files, Phase/Step numbering consistent.'

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file curriculum/slides/tree-on-friday-roadmap-on-monday.md -> 'OK - 1 files, no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut.' grep -inE 'below|above|this page' on body -> 0.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no in-body links (signals.has_urls false, no link syntax)

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/slides/tree-on-friday-roadmap-on-monday.md -> 'oversized: 0', 1 slide within 210 words / 6 bullets.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lecture-surface header, a paired scene contrast (L1) rather than a bare label; it asserts what happened on Friday vs Monday and the body bears it out. Closest to a label: it has no verb, but rule exempts catalogue/orientation and this is the scene-claim the squint title chose; non-blocking either way.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L8 sentence 'So the decision went to whatever was already planned, and the tree became a picture of what the team believed.' is the closest to a kicker but carries the consequence (decision defaulted to the roadmap) not a restatement of the header. No doctrine restatement, no design commentary.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no header rename or provenance note of the 'from <old-file>' shape in the maintainer block; first-cut slide

notes: Single-chunk slide file; rules_evaluated carries all 17 rules from the brief.
